title: Intercom API Review: Full Developer Breakdown [2026]
snippet:
**Intercom's REST API**, currently at [version 2.15](https://developers.intercom.com/docs/references/introduction), covers more ground than most APIs in the customer service category. The docs are public at [developers.intercom.com](https://developers.intercom.com/), official SDKs cover six server-side languages, rate limits are published at 10,000 calls per minute per app, and the endpoint catalogue spans contacts, conversations, tickets, help center articles, workflows, and the Fin AI Agent.

| **Rate limits** | [10,000 calls/min](https://developers.intercom.com/docs/references/rest-api/errors/rate-limiting/) per app; 25,000 calls/min per workspace |

| **Pricing / access** | Included on all paid plans; [$29/seat/mo](https://www.intercom.com/pricing) entry (Essential, billed annually) |

No permanent free API tier; the 14-day trial ends and access stops without a paid plan |

API access starts with any paid **Intercom** plan.
The [pricing page](https://www.intercom.com/pricing) lists API access across Essential ($29/seat/month), Advanced ($85/seat/month), and Expert ($132/seat/month), with no separate developer signup or API-specific fee. A [14-day cardless free trial](https://www.intercom.com/legal/terms-and-policies) gives access to the full API during the trial period.

**Intercom** bundles API access into its paid plans rather than charging per call or per credit. The [pricing page](https://www.intercom.com/pricing) lists API access across all three tiers:
| **Plan** | **Seat price (billed annually)** | **API access** |
|---|---|---|
| **Essential** | $29/seat/month | Included |
| **Advanced** | $85/seat/month | Included |
| **Expert** | $132/seat/month | Included |
There are no per-call charges, no API-specific credit costs, and no metered pricing. Private app development workspaces are free to create but limited in functionality and restricted to the US region.
The real cost for a developer building on this API is not the API itself but the platform features the API operates within:
- **Fin AI Agent:** [$0.99 per resolved outcome](https://www.intercom.com/pricing) on top of the seat subscription, charged only when Fin resolves a conversation. Unresolved handoffs to humans are not charged.
- **Copilot (unlimited usage add-on):** $29/agent/month on [annual prepay](https://www.intercom.com/help/en/articles/9121384-copilot-included-and-unlimited-usage) beyond the 10 free conversations per agent per month included in all plans.

- After your free trial ends, [Intercom's products start at $49/month](https://www.intercom.io/pricing).
